# no-superfluous-tags

Disallow tags that repeat a tag of an enclosing Feature, Rule, or Scenario.

| Category | Recommended | Safe autofix | Default options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| tags | no | no | none |

Finds tags repeated from the enclosing Feature, Rule, or Scenario.

## Configuration

```json
{ "rules": { "no-superfluous-tags": "error" } }
```

## Triggered by

```text
@smoke Feature with @smoke Scenario
```
